purpose: Bind one paid repair run together as a token-keyed state machine, enforced server-side so payment gates the service - the exact coupling whose earlier breakage sank prior submissions. A token names a live PAID session (created only after a fulfilled Stripe checkout, incl. a 100%-off comp) and advances created -> diagnosed -> (consent) -> repaired -> complete with a 3-day TTL. A repair plan is authored and recorded ONLY for a token naming a live paid session; an unknown/expired token is refused (402), no session created, no plan.

capabilities.name: create
capabilities.function: createSession(stripeSessionId, email, clientRef): mint a token bound to a fulfilled checkout; store createdAt + expiresAt (SESSION_TTL_MS = 3 days).

capabilities.name: read
capabilities.function: getSession(token): return the live session or null; expire past the 3-day TTL.

capabilities.name: advance
capabilities.function: transitionState(token, newState): move created->diagnosed->consented->repaired->complete under an optimistic-concurrency write; reject an out-of-order or post-TTL transition.

capabilities.name: pay_gate
capabilities.function: handleNativePlan records a plan only for a token naming a live PAID session (single atomic read+conditional write, TOTEM-X-0065); unknown/expired -> 402, no session, no plan.

demonstration.input_fixture: a fulfilled Stripe checkout session id (live) or a forged token (negative case)
expected_outputs: paid checkout -> token minted -> plan recordable in state diagnosed
forged/unknown token -> 402 unpaid, sessions stay 0, no plan authored
a concurrent consent/state change returns 409 rather than being clobbered

evidence.source: Placed from pronto-server-cloudrun.mjs (createSession/getSession/transitionState/handleNativePlan; SESSION_TTL_MS; server-side pay gate proven fail-closed, TOTEM-X-0065/X-0034).
